_doc: Spell data that is not about one spell. Each spell lives in data/spells/<id>.json (sections: spell = identity, numbers, ranks, presentation; recipe = combination; shape = parts and cast rules; damage = damage types and statuses per part; generic = bare/draft definition). Reassembled by scripts/core/SpellLibrary.gd.

docs.recipes: Combination spells (doc 03). A recipe joins two ingredient spells; overrides are merged over the spell info when cast. scaling: how the combination grows, one expression per spell-info field ('=' prefix): own = its own rank - 1, bonus(id) = an ingredient's rank - 1, dmg(id, fallback) = an ingredient's damage at its rank (its own rank curve). rank_note: the next rank's level-up line (rank = current rank).
docs.spell_shapes: Spell shapes as data (doc 19 §4.1): the parts each shipped spell and combination is made of, keyed by spell id. Expressions start with '='; see scripts/engine/SpellTemplate.gd for the template rules. Numbers live in spells.json, recipes.json and spell_damage.json.
docs.spell_damage: Typed damage for shipping spells (doc 21 §5). damage = each damage type as a multiple of the spell's base hit (may add up past 1); raw shares use the spell's element on the type chart. element defaults to spells.json. statuses are applied on hit: {status, strength?, stacks?, duration?, no_freeze?, no_stun?}. parts: per part (named as in scripts/engine/LegacyBridge.gd), that part's own damage and statuses, which replace the spell's. pure is untyped damage no resistance reduces.
docs.generic_spells: Generic spells built from parts (doc 18 §4). acquire: bare = always castable bare forms (deliberately weak); data_only = defined for the engine and tests, not acquirable yet.

unlock_conditions.persistent_xp: Player must have accumulated specified persistent XP
unlock_conditions.achievement: Player must have earned specified achievement
unlock_conditions.character: Player must have unlocked specified character
unlock_conditions.spell_mastery: Player must have mastered specified spell
unlock_conditions.survive_time: Player must survive specified time in a single run
unlock_conditions.enemies_killed: Player must kill specified number of enemies

preparation._doc: The pre-run spellbook (scripts/Preparation.gd): ordered slots, the level each slot opens at, and the kit a new profile starts with. Spells marked preparable can be prepared; opens_kit false keeps a spell out of slot 1 (it cannot kill things on its own).
